# Safwan Digital — Mohammed Safwan

> Mohammed Safwan is a digital marketing generalist and consultant from Palakkad, Kerala, India, working in digital marketing since 2021. He works across Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO and AI search optimisation (AEO and GEO), mostly with healthcare and B2B brands. He works full-time with a digital marketing agency in Bangalore (remotely) and takes freelance consultations on the side. He serves businesses across Kerala and India, and brands in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the UAE and other GCC countries. He speaks English and Malayalam.

## Quick facts
- Name: Mohammed Safwan (brand: Safwan Digital, website: https://safwandigital.com)
- Location: Palakkad, Kerala, India (works remotely with clients across India and the GCC)
- Role: digital marketing generalist and consultant; full-time at a digital marketing agency in Bangalore, freelance consultations on the side (not a full-time freelancer)
- Experience: in digital marketing since 2021; BA English, then a digital marketing course, then learned on the job in agency, in-house and freelance roles
- Channels: Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram, lead ads), Google Ads (Search, Performance Max), SEO and local SEO, AEO and GEO (AI search), organic Instagram growth
- Industries he knows best: healthcare (hospitals, clinics, doctors; works within NMC advertising guidelines) and B2B and local businesses
- Main way to work with him: a 1–2 hour one-to-one consultation that reviews your ads, website and marketing plan and ends with clear next steps
- Also available: Google Business Profile setup, landing page reviews, social media content plans, in-house team training, workshops and guest sessions for academies, colleges, companies and organisations, and hiring help for digital marketing roles (job description, practical test task, interviews)
- Languages: English, Malayalam

## Selected results (from his portfolio)
- Allergy Asthma Foundation (outpatient allergy and asthma clinics in Kerala, Meta lead ads): ₹3,28,100 revenue from ₹49,634 ad spend in September 2026 (about 6.6x); ₹1,21,600 from ₹9,609 in 1–10 October 2026. No surgeries or high-ticket procedures. Achieved by switching from click-to-WhatsApp ads to Meta lead forms with qualifying questions, one campaign per location, and tracking every lead to revenue.
- Dayana Fashion (women's dress manufacturer, Perinthalmanna, Kerala): a ₹1,500 Meta Ads test brought 60+ enquiries and about ₹6 lakh in wholesale sales.
- Cleaning company in Qatar (Google Ads): 3x return on about ₹1 lakh ad spend.
- Asker Sweets (food manufacturer, Riyadh): #1 on Google for samosa manufacturers in Riyadh and Saudi Arabia, including AI Overviews.
- Bissan Ice (commercial ice manufacturer, Saudi Arabia): website revamp and SEO to the top of Google for target keywords.
- VSH Hospital, Bangalore (done as part of an agency): SEO, Meta Ads and Google Ads across six departments.
- Ara Skin Clinic, Bangalore (done as part of an agency): Meta and Google Ads; one dermal fillers Search campaign brought 1.57K clicks and 28 leads within ₹21.5K.
- Organic growth: an architecture firm's Instagram from 150 to 7,000 followers without ads; content strategy for Dr. Vishnu Vasudevan's growth from about 3K to 50K followers.
